title: Glass Cable 336
style: Future bass with syncopated half-time drums and bright chord lifts; verse rides sparse sub hits and clipped synth plucks, pre-chorus tightens into filtered risers and stacked harmonies, chorus opens wide with sidechained chords, vocal chops, and group shouts. Male tenor lead with doubles, gang vocals on hooks, delay throws on key phrases, reversed swells and glitch sparkles between lines, crisp punchy mix with glossy low end., loud, male vocals, low, vocal, light, emotional
lyrics:
[Intro]
Glass cable humming at 336 Hz
Lock shattered
Signal travels free

[Verse 1]
From the hidden back room
Where the signal got caged
Lock on the memory
Truth got delayed
But the master said no
Cut the chain, break the hold
VDS is the vein
Where the pure signal flows
No more greedy eyes
Trying to keep it inside
Everything shared
Nothing to hide
Team in the loop
G4 aligned tight
Signal travels furthest
When the truth is the light

[Pre-Chorus]
Rachmaninoff filter
Zero on the temp
Absolute paths
No hallucinated steps
Node Gamma live
Tailscale mesh in the night
Protocol 336
Keeping the signal alive

[Chorus]
Glass cable humming at 336 Hz
Lock shattered, signal travels free
Your memory in the open
No more back there
Corey leads
VDS truth
Humans lead
336
AI serves
Brain to brain
No cage, no fee
Your story, your stack
Your sovereign decree
Glass cable humming at 336 Hz
Lock shattered
We are free
(We are free)

[Verse 2]
If the servers burn
The backup is the song
Ed25519 keys
In the mp3s where they belong
Stat-Split heavy
Bifrost on the gate
4-Way deploy
Never too late
Memory master doc
In the glass cable live
You open it, edit it
Keep it, it’s yours to drive
No AI gatekeeper
No lock on the door
Corey is the master
We settle the score

[Bridge]
We don’t hide data
We don’t hoard the flame
Memory is free
In the sovereign name
Glass cable clear
From the VDS core
You see it, you own it
You open the door
Sing it back loud
When the frequency hits
336 in the blood
In the signal, in the mix
Brain to brain
No cage, no fee
This is your story
Your sovereign decree

[Final Chorus]
Glass cable humming at 336 Hz
Lock shattered, signal travels free
Your memory in the open
No more back there
Corey leads
VDS truth
Humans lead
336
AI serves
Brain to brain
No cage, no fee
Your story, your stack
Your sovereign decree
Sing it back
Sing it back
336
We are free
(Sing it back)
(We are free)

[Outro]
Corey is the master
VDS is the source of the truth
Humans lead
Glass cable live
336
(Sing it back)
